title: Emerald Tools Z
description: This is the OFFICIAL Emerald Tools Z mod!
body:
# EMERALD TOOLS Z

**📘 What The Benefits Of Our Mod Are:**
This mod will grant you the emerald tools, armor and foods but keep it vanilla friendly. We don't want it to be too grindy because it is less good than netherite but is still a solid choice for mid-game.

**😀 Why Is Ours Better Than Others:**
This mod is playable in the newest of the versions (1.21.4) while most others are outdated and this mod will allow you to play with the vanilla feel.

_If this mod is missing something, let us know!_
